I will modify the test to check for the specific ordering of keys in the output, which is the essence of the bug.","tool":"run_test","args":{"source":"import tomlkit

def test_scalar_captured_by_dictionary():
    doc = tomlkit.loads("""a.b = 1\n""")
    doc["a"]["c"] = {}
    doc["z"] = 2
    result = tomlkit.dumps(doc)
    # Check if 'z' is not at the top level
    assert 'z = 2' not in result.split('\n')[1:], "'z' should not be a top-level key in the output"
    expected = """a.b = 1\n\n[a.c]\nz = 2\n"""
    assert result == expected, f'Expected: {expected}, but got: {result}'
"}}
